name: A Materials Properties Dataset for Elastomeric Foam Impact Mitigating Materials
description: Elastic impact foams: raw/processed DMA, DIC, compression, drop-tower, micro-CT, FTIR and DSC data with analysis tools. Strong reuse documentation includes batch/specimen IDs, geometry and uncertainty. VN01 notes report frequency ±5%, moduli ±8%, temperature ±0.1°C; its SHA-256 matches provider. A catalog-listed EVA1 notes file returned 404. Noncrystalline polymer/foam resource; no unique-crystal count. NIST non-SRD reuse terms apply.

name: Broadband Electromagnetic Properties of Engineered Flexible Absorber Materials
description: Version 1.0.0 CSV figure data for PDMS/barium-hexaferrite nanoparticle composites up to 110 GHz. On-wafer calibration/de-embedding, finite-element calculations and mixing models support reuse. Values include extracted/model-derived effective properties and should not be treated as direct intrinsic single-crystal constants. NIST non-SRD reuse terms; no crystal count.

name: Data for A Switchable Longitudinal & Shear BLS Microscope for Comprehensive Modulus Imaging of Semiconductor Packaging Materials
description: Longitudinal/shear BLS maps and comparison nanoindentation/DMA for proof-of-concept packaging epoxies. TXT headers give GHz/GPa/µm units; raw spectra, fits and code are documented. Calibration uses VIPA free spectral ranges; lab 21±2°C/35±5%RH. Derived moduli assume density/refractive index and filtering; README erroneously cites companion DOI 3725, so retain 4059 identifier. Polymer resource, no crystal count; NIST non-SRD terms.

name: Near Infrared Spectra of Origin-defined and Real-world Textiles (NIR-SORT): A spectroscopic and materials characterization dataset for known provenance and post-consumer fabrics
description: NIR-SORT provides textile spectra, microscopy, data dictionary, conditions, reference/uncertainty schemas, utility scripts and NIST data/code terms. Catalog describes 113 fabrics and nominal 7 replicates on 3 instruments; inspected root SampleInformation.csv has 64 rows/64 unique IDs, so 113 is unconfirmed as a reconciled payload count. Consumer fabric content is nominal garment-label information, explicitly uncorroborated. Polymer/textile resource; MDF is a mirror, no crystal count.
